params.body:
Sixth measurement to carry verdicts, and the one four cards read (Pages and SEO, Weakest pages, Links, Speed).

| facet | thresholds, worst first |
| --- | --- |
| tags | `SEO_WEAK` (<85, month), `SEO_STRONG` (ok) |
| broken | `PAGES_BROKEN` (week), `PAGES_HEALTHY` (ok) |
| missing | `TAGS_MISSING` (title, description, h1, alt summed as `tagGaps`; month), `TAGS_COMPLETE` (ok) |
| extras | `EXTRAS_MISSING` (canonical, og:image as `extraGaps`; background), `EXTRAS_COMPLETE` (ok) |
| thin | `THIN_PAGES` (background), `THIN_NONE` (ok) |
| robots | `ROBOTS_MISSING` (month), `ROBOTS_PRESENT` (ok) |
| links | `LINKS_BROKEN_INTERNAL` (month), `LINKS_BROKEN` (other sites, background), `LINKS_OK` (ok) |
| speed | `PAGES_SLOW` (avgMs > 1200, month), `PAGES_FAST` (ok) |

Levels copied from the cards; the 1200 ms sat in the Speed card. Four new flat facts (`tagGaps`, `extraGaps`, `brokenLinks`, `brokenLinksInternal`) let the registry read what the cards summed in PHP. Without a sitemap only robots.txt is judged; without timings there is no word on speed.

Tests: four cases in `PagesScanTest`. Suite 607 green, PHPStan and Pint clean. Branched from main at 21cbd5a (after #175). Portal follows with the four cards reading these facets.
params.title: Pages judges its own facts, one facet per question the cards ask
